description.zh:
1934 年 2 月至 1936 年 10 月，中国工农红军主力从长江南北各根据地向陕北和川陕甘地区进行战略转移。

> 本数据为初稿：路线为示意简化，并标示国民党军追堵与封锁方向；红二、六军团、红二十五军、陕北红军、红十五军团及其东征西征节点已补入，中央红军与红二、红四方面军翻越的主要雪山垭口（夹金山、梦笔山、长板山、昌德山、达古山、党岭山、雅哈雪山、大雪山、沙鲁里山、藏巴拉山、月日茨普、恶热拉、麦拉、生欧拉，以及红四军奔袭瞻化翻越的四座垭口）已按点位补充；1936 年 8—10 月的岷洮西固战役、岷州会议、洮州会议、成徽两康战役、五龙山与华家岭阻击战、红二方面军 10 月过渭河北撤节点、通庄静会战役与攻克会宁城、青江驿界石铺会师已补入；乌蒙山回旋战已按野马川会议、以则河、哲庄坝、来宾铺逐点拆分；红九军团 1935 年 3—5 月单独行动（马鬃岭分兵与长干山、枫香坝佯动、老木孔、瓢儿井、宣威、会泽、冬瓜坪、华弹阻敌、礼州会合）已补入；中央红军 1935 年 4 月抢渡北盘江、逼近昆明、鲁口哨渡江令与柯渡部署已补入；红一军团 5 月 1 日至 3 日化装智取禄劝、武定、元谋已补入；泸定桥之后化林坪、飞越岭、泸定会议、天全、芦山宝兴防线与硗碛备战已补入；红四方面军 1935 年 5 月土门战役、千佛山阻击战、占领茂县与 6 月攻占懋功、前出达维已补入；中央红军 6 月 2—8 日经荥经茶合岗、水子地翻越泡桐岗与胡长保牺牲已补入；懋功会师联欢会、两河口会师大会与张国焘到两河口、攻占卓克基与卓克基会议已补入；中央机关 7 月 10 日进驻黑水芦花寨、毛儿盖战斗与毛儿盖筹粮“割麦证”、松潘战役计划流产与《夏洮战役计划》、右路军先头部队 8 月 21 日出发过草地已补入；乌江渡口已按江界河、回龙场、茶山关、孙家渡、桃子台、楠木渡、袁家渡等逐点补充；中央红军路线网已完成一次结构性校订：补齐夹金山—达维—懋功断头线，合并泸定—夹金山重复走廊，红九军团树桔渡渡江后经华弹、宁南、普格至礼州归建，4 月乌江—贵阳—北盘江与北盘江—皎平渡两段分工，1936 年直罗镇—延川、东征与西征分段，主线各段首尾相接；4 月中旬北盘江按右路（长顺—江龙—坝草—白层—贞丰）、左路（紫云—册亨—安龙—兴仁）分线，坝草至坡扪、白层、者坪至弄洋三座浮桥写入路线正文；4 月底鲁口哨渡江令后的左（一军团）、右（三军团）、中央（军委纵队与红五军团）三路纵队已分线画出，中央纵队不再绕行嵩明、禄劝；红二、六军团湘鄂川黔苏区阶段已按木黄—南腰界—百户司—招头寨—永顺、永顺—桑植、塔卧—陈家河、沙道沟—高罗—忠堡、沙道沟—板栗园及省委驻地迁移（大庸—塔卧—兴隆街—茨岩塘）重画，苏区内部线改为桑植—塔卧、塔卧—兴隆街、兴隆街—茨岩塘、兴隆街—沙道沟四条常驻线；1936 年东征、西征与三军会师已按直罗镇—瓦窑堡—延长—清涧、清涧河口—石楼—关上村—兑九峪—临汾—延川、延川—吴起镇—环县—豫旺堡、豫旺堡—界石铺—青江驿—会宁及会宁—青江驿—将台堡重画，直罗镇坐标由富县县城改正为镇区点，关上村战斗改属红一军团，并补瓦窑堡会议；红四方面军 1935—1936 年段已拆为懋功—两河口—卓克基—芦花—毛儿盖—班佑—巴西—包座（北上）、包座—绥靖—丹巴—懋功—宝兴—天全—芦山—百丈（南下）、名山—宝兴—丹巴—道孚—炉霍—甘孜（西进康北）、甘孜—阿坝—包座—腊子口—哈达铺—岷州—临潭—通渭（北上甘南）与通渭—华家岭—会宁（红五军后卫）五段，原「懋功—会宁（示意）」16 个月复合线已取消，包座事件补入作战经过；事件日期、地点与表述待史料校订。
description.en: From October 1934 to October 1936, the main forces of the Chinese Red Army moved from their bases in southern and central China to northern Shaanxi. The atlas also marks the KMT pursuit and blockade forces; the Second and Sixth Army Groups, the 25th Army, the Shaanxi Red Army and the 15th Army Corps are included, and the main snow-mountain passes crossed by the Central Red Army and the Second and Fourth Front Armies (Jiajin, Mengbi, Changban, Changde, Dagu, Dangling, Yaha, the Greater and Lesser Snow Mountains, Shaluli, Zangbala, Yuericipu, Ere, Maila, Sheng’oula, and the four passes of the 4th Army’s raid on Zhanhua) are recorded as separate points. The Min–Tao–Xigu campaign, the Minzhou and Taozhou meetings, the Cheng–Hui–Liang–Kang campaign, and the Wulongshan and Huajialing blocking battles, the Second Front Army’s October retreat across the Wei River, the Tong–Zhuang–Jing–Hui campaign, the capture of Huining, and the Qingjiangyi–Jieshipu link-up are included; the Wumeng Mountains campaign is split into point-level events at Yemachuan, Yizehe, Zhezhuangba, and Laibinpu; the Ninth Army Corps’ independent March–May 1935 operations (the Mazongling dispersal and Changqianshan–Fengxiangba feint, Laomukong, Piaoerjing, Xuanwei, Huize, Dongguaping, the Huatan blocking action and the Lizhou link-up) are included; the Central Red Army’s April 1935 Beipan crossing, Kunming feint, Lukoushao crossing order, and Kedu deployment are included; the 1st Army Corps’ disguised seizure of Luquan, Wuding, and Yuanmou on 1–3 May is included; the post-Luding actions at Hualinping and Feiyueling, the Luding meeting, Tianquan, the Lushan–Baoxing line, and the Qiaoqi preparations are included; the Fourth Front Army's May 1935 Tumen campaign, the Qianfo Mountain blocking battle, the capture of Mao county, and the June seizure of Maogong and advance to Dawei are included; the Central Red Army's 2–8 June passage through Chahegang and Shuizidi in Yingjing, the crossing of Paotonggang, and the death of Hu Changbao are included; the Maogong link-up celebration, the Lianghekou welcome rally for Zhang Guotao, the seizure of Zhuokeji, and the Zhuokeji meeting are included; the Central Committee's arrival at Luhua in Heishui on 10 July, the fight for Maoergai, the 'wheat-cutting certificates' left during the Maoergai grain collection, the abandonment of the Songpan campaign in favour of the Xiatao plan, and the Right Route Army's advance guard setting out across the grasslands on 21 August are included. The Wu River crossings are recorded point by point at Jiangjiehe, Huilongchang, Chashanguan, Sunjiadu, Taozitai, Nanmudu, and Yuanjiadu. The Central Red Army route network has been structurally revised: the Jiajin–Dawei–Maogong dead end is closed, the duplicate Luding–Jiajin corridor is merged, the Ninth Army Corps’ return from Shuju Ferry via Huatan, Ningnan and Puge to Lizhou is drawn, the April Wu River–Guiyang–Beipan and Beipan–Jiaopingdu legs are separated, and the 1936 Zhiluozhen–Yanchuan, eastern expedition and western expedition legs are split, so that consecutive main-line segments meet end to end. In mid-April the Beipan crossing is split into a right column (Changshun–Jianglong–Bacao–Baiceng–Zhenfeng) and a left column (Ziyun–Ceheng–Anlong–Xingren), with the three pontoon bridges at Bacao–Pomen, Baiceng and Zheyang–Nongyang described in the route text. The three columns ordered at Lukoushao in late April — left (First Army Corps), right (Third Army Corps) and centre (Military Commission column and Fifth Army Corps) — are now drawn separately, and the central column no longer detours through Songming and Luquan. The Second and Sixth Army Groups’ Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou phase has been redrawn along Muhuang–Nanjie–Baihusi–Zhaotouzhai–Yongshun, Yongshun–Sangzhi, Tawo–Chenjiahe, Shadaogou–Gaoluo–Zhongbao and Shadaogou–Banliyuan, with the provincial seat moves (Dayong–Tawo–Xinglongjie–Ciyantang); the internal Soviet-area lines are now Sangzhi–Tawo, Tawo–Xinglongjie, Xinglongjie–Ciyantang and Xinglongjie–Shadaogou. The 1936 Eastern Expedition, Western Expedition and three-army link-up have been redrawn along Zhiluozhen–Wayaobao–Yanchang–Qingjian, Qingjian Hekou–Shilou–Guanshang–Duijiuyu–Linfen–Yanchuan, Yanchuan–Wuqi–Huanxian–Yuwangbao, Yuwangbao–Jieshipu–Qingjiangyi–Huining and Huining–Qingjiangyi–Jiangtaibao. The Zhiluozhen coordinate has been corrected from Fu county town to the town itself, the Guanshang battle reassigned to the 1st Army Corps, and the Wayaobao meeting added. The Fourth Front Army’s 1935–1936 routes have been split into five legs: Maogong–Lianghekou–Zhuokeji–Luhua–Maoergai–Banyou–Baxi–Baozuo (northward), Baozuo–Suijing–Danba–Maogong–Baoxing–Tianquan–Lushan–Baizhang (southward), Mingshan–Baoxing–Danba–Daofu–Luhuo–Ganzi (west to Kham), Ganzi–Aba–Baozuo–Lazikou–Hadapu–Minxian–Lintan–Tongwei (north to southern Gansu) and Tongwei–Huajialing–Huining (5th Corps rearguard). The former 16-month “Maogong–Huining” composite line has been removed and the Baozuo battle event expanded. Event dates, places and wording await historical review.

description.zh: 长征主线，1934 年 10 月从瑞金出发，1935 年 10 月到达吴起镇。
description.en: Main line of the Long March; departed Ruijin in October 1934 and reached Wuqi in October 1935.

description.zh: 1935 年 11 月从湘鄂川黔根据地出发，1936 年 10 月到达将台堡。
description.en: Departed the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou base area in November 1935 and reached Jiangtaibao in October 1936.

description.zh: 1934 年 8 月从湘赣苏区西征，10 月在贵州木黄与红二军团会师，随后共同长征。
description.en: Set out westward from the Hunan-Jiangxi Soviet area in August 1934, met the Second Army Group at Muhuang, Guizhou, in October, and joined the Long March.

description.zh: 从川陕根据地出发，1935 年 6 月与中央红军在懋功会师。
description.en: Departed the Sichuan-Shaanxi base area and met the Central Red Army at Maogong in June 1935.

description.zh: 1934 年 11 月从鄂豫皖根据地出发，1935 年 9 月到达陕北永坪。
description.en: Departed the Hubei-Henan-Anhui base area in November 1934 and reached Yongping in northern Shaanxi in September 1935.

description.zh: 1935 年 9 月由红二十五军与红二十六、二十七军在永坪合编，徐海东任军团长，程子华任政委，刘志丹任副军团长兼参谋长，是陕北红军的直接延续。随后经劳山、榆林桥、直罗镇，1936 年 2—5 月东征、5—7 月西征，10 月攻克会宁迎接红二、红四方面军，长征结束。
description.en: Formed at Yongping in September 1935 from the 25th, 26th and 27th Red Armies under Xu Haidong (commander), Cheng Zihua (political commissar) and Liu Zhidan (deputy commander and chief of staff), it directly continued the northern Shaanxi Red Army. It fought at Laoshan, Yulinqiao and Zhiluozhen, conducted the Eastern Expedition of February–May 1936 and the Western Expedition of May–July, and took Huining in October 1936 to meet the Second and Fourth Front Armies as the Long March ended.

description.zh: 陕北红军，包括红二十六军、红二十七军及陕甘边、陕北地方武装。1931 年 10 月晋西游击队转战南梁与刘志丹部会合，1932 年 12 月改编为红二十六军；1933 年 11 月包家寨会议后以南梁为中心创建陕甘边根据地，1934 年 2 月成立陕甘边区革命委员会、11 月成立苏维埃政府；陕北方向 1934 年 7—8 月打破第一次“围剿”，1935 年 1 月成立陕北省苏维埃政府和红二十七军，2 月与陕甘边统一为西北根据地，6 月底取得第二次反“围剿”胜利。1935 年 9 月与红二十五军在永坪会师，合编为红十五军团；此后经劳山、榆林桥、直罗镇、东征、西征至 1936 年 10 月长征结束，见「红十五军团」实体。
description.en: The northern Shaanxi Red Army, comprising the 26th and 27th Red Armies and the Shaanxi-Gansu border and northern Shaanxi local forces. In October 1931 the Shanxi-west guerrillas reached Nanliang and joined Liu Zhidan’s force, becoming the 26th Red Army in December 1932; after the Baojiazhai conference of November 1933 the base was built around Nanliang, with a revolutionary committee in February 1934 and a Soviet government in November 1934. In northern Shaanxi the first encirclement was broken in July–August 1934; in January 1935 the provincial Soviet government and the 27th Red Army were founded, in February the two bases were unified, and by the end of June the second encirclement was broken. In September 1935 the force met the 25th Army at Yongping and was reorganized as the 15th Corps; its subsequent history through Laoshan, Yulinqiao, Zhiluozhen, the Eastern and Western Expeditions to the end of the Long March in October 1936 is carried by the 15th Corps entity.

description.zh: 蒋介石嫡系部队，含薛岳、周浑元、吴奇伟等追击纵队及第 60 师等部，在赣、湘、黔、川、陕方向担任追击与堵截。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek’s central forces, including the pursuit columns of Xue Yue, Zhou Hunyuan and Wu Qiwei and the 60th Division, operating in Jiangxi, Hunan, Guizhou, Sichuan and Shaanxi. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 湖南地方部队，含何键（后刘建绪）第四路军、李觉纵队等，担任湘江封锁线与湘鄂川黔“围剿”。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Hunan provincial forces, including He Jian’s (later Liu Jianxu’s) Fourth Route Army and Li Jue’s column, which held the Xiang River blockade line and encircled the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou Soviet area. Unit designations follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 广东地方部队，陈济棠第一集团军（余汉谋、叶肇等部），在赣南设第一道封锁线，并在湘南良田、宜章、乐昌一带防守第三道封锁线。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Guangdong provincial forces of Chen Jitang’s First Group Army (Yu Hanmou, Ye Zhao and others), which held the first blockade line in southern Jiangxi and defended the third blockade line around Liangtian, Yizhang and Lechang in southern Hunan. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 广西地方部队，白崇禧、夏威、廖磊等部，参加湘江第四道封锁线。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Guangxi provincial forces under Bai Chongxi, Xia Wei and Liao Lei, which took part in the fourth blockade line along the Xiang River. Unit designations follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 贵州地方部队，王家烈第二十五军及侯之担等部，防守乌江。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Guizhou provincial forces of Wang Jialie’s 25th Army and Hou Zhidan’s units, which defended the Wu River. Unit designations follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 云南地方部队，龙云、孙渡等部，防守金沙江。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Yunnan provincial forces under Long Yun and Sun Du, which defended the Jinsha River. Unit designations follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 四川地方部队，刘湘、刘文辉、邓锡侯、杨森等部，防守大渡河并堵截红四方面军。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Sichuan provincial forces under Liu Xiang, Liu Wenhui, Deng Xihou and Yang Sen, which defended the Dadu River and blocked the Red Fourth Front Army. Unit designations follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 东北军张学良部，含第 67 军、第 109 师、骑兵军等，参加陕甘第三次“围剿”、六盘山与直罗镇作战。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang’s Northeast Army, including the 67th Corps, 109th Division and cavalry corps, which took part in the third encirclement campaign in Shaanxi-Gansu and the fighting at the Liupan Mountains and Zhiluozhen. Unit designations follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 冯玉祥旧部，庞炳勋第 40 军（第 115 旅、骑兵团等），1934 年 11 月在方城独树镇堵截红二十五军。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Former Feng Yuxiang troops, including Pang Bingxun’s 40th Army (115th Brigade and cavalry regiment), which intercepted the Red 25th Army at Dushuzhen, Fangcheng, in November 1934. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 陕西地方部队，杨虎城第十七路军（警备第 1 旅等），在陕南追击红二十五军，1935 年 7 月袁家沟口一战被歼。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Shaanxi provincial forces of Yang Hucheng’s 17th Route Army (including the 1st Security Brigade), which pursued the Red 25th Army in southern Shaanxi; the brigade was destroyed at Yuanjiagoukou in July 1935. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 山西地方部队，阎锡山晋绥军，追堵红军东征。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Shanxi provincial forces under Yan Xishan, which pursued and blocked the Red Army’s Eastern Expedition. Unit designations follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 甘肃、宁夏、青海地方部队，含鲁大昌新编第 14 师、马鸿逵与马鸿宾等部，防守腊子口、堵截西征。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Gansu, Ningxia and Qinghai provincial forces, including Lu Dachang’s New 14th Division and the forces of Ma Hongkui and Ma Hongbin, which held Lazikou and blocked the Western Expedition. Unit designations follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.
